(Japanese: '''プラズマ団内部のゲノセクト極秘映像''' ''Top Secret Internal Team Plasma Genesect Video'') is an animated short that was made to promote ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. It was first screened at the {{jwp|次世代ワールドホビーフェア|Next Generation World Hobby Fair}} '13 Winter, which was held at the {{wp|Nagoya Dome}} in {{wp|Nagoya}}, Japan on January 20, 2013, {{wp|Makuhari Messe}} in {{wp|Chiba, Chiba|Chiba}}, Japan from January 26 to 27, 2013, the {{wp|Fukuoka Yahuoku! Dome}} in {{wp|Fukuoka}}, Japan on February 3, 2013, and at the {{wp|Kyocera Dome}} in {{wp|Osaka}}, Japan on February 10, 2013.<ref>[https://pokemorning.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1052.html 次世代ワールドホビーフェア'13 Winter 名古屋大会。ポケモン目指し！ - ポケモン ブログ｜わさび's Blog Pokemorning!]</ref><ref>[https://game.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/585205.html 「次世代ワールドホビーフェア'13 Winter・東京大会」が幕張メッセで開幕。最新のアーケードゲームからコンシューマータイトル、ホビーまでズラリ勢揃い - GAME Watch]</ref><ref>[http://blog.livedoor.jp/express_tsubame/archives/52193054.html 次世代ワールドホビーフェア'13 福岡 : 787.TSUBAMEのきまぐれブログ]</ref><ref>[http://funamidingo.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-176.html 次世代WHF'13に行ってきました - フナミの前線基地]</ref> It was subsequently posted on the official Japanese [[YouTube]] channel to promote the {{TCG|Megalo Cannon}} TCG expansion on February 15, 2013, and was made available on the {{nw|Nintendo Video}} service in Japan alongside the March 7 trailer for the movie from March 13 to April 23, 2013.<ref>[https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm20379336 ゲノセクト極秘映像 - Niconico Video]</ref> A Korean dub was [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c3fWMhw6c0A released] on the official Korean YouTube channel on May 8, 2013.

==Plot==
The short details "Project G", [[Team Plasma]]'s plan to revive and modify {{p|Genesect}}. It introduces the four [[Drive]]s that Genesect can use, Genesect's {{tt|通常形態|つうじょうけいたい}} ''normal configuration'', {{tt|高速飛行形態|こうそくひこうけいたい}} ''high-speed flight configuration'', and a {{Shiny|Red}} Genesect who can use {{m|Extreme Speed}}.

==Trivia==
* The portion of the video depicting a computer interface with a rotating diagram of Genesect in the center and several windows on both sides resembles the screen that {{an|N}} views at the beginning of ''[[BW110|The Name's N!]]''.
* Project G is mentioned by name in ''[[BW117|Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!]]'', when a {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}} informs [[Ghetsis]] that a search party has not yet been able to locate the target for the project.
